arg.name: mode
arg.description: Mode of operation: MAP / PP / RL / MPC / AC4MPC / (FTG). methods in brackets have not been implemented

arg.name: checkpoint
arg.description: RL mode only: path to a checkpoint saved by f1tenth_parallel_sim scripts/train.py

arg.name: ac4mpc_policy
arg.description: AC4MPC mode only: the TorchScript policy exported from a checkpoint by f1tenth_parallel_sim scripts/export_policy.py

arg.name: ac4mpc_mode
arg.description: AC4MPC mode only: critic (value terminal cost) / actor (actor seeds and competes) / full (both)

arg.name: ac4mpc_value_weight
arg.description: AC4MPC mode only: the paper's beta, the scale on the critic in the QP

arg.name: ac4mpc_reinit_period
arg.description: AC4MPC mode only: steps between re-seeding the parallel solver with the actor's rollout

arg.name: ac4mpc_eval_correction
arg.description: AC4MPC mode only: alpha, actor feedback on a candidate's commands when it is scored

arg.name: ac4mpc_eval_rollout
arg.description: AC4MPC mode only: actor steps past the horizon when a candidate is scored

arg.name: direction
arg.description: RL / MPC / AC4MPC modes only: 'ccw' / 'cw', the driving direction (the RL policy was trained for one)

arg.name: odom_topic
arg.description: RL / MPC / AC4MPC modes only: the state estimate, in any frame. /state_estimation/odom_map is the smooth map-frame one (local odometry plus the corrected map->odom, from state_estimation's map_odom_node; the simulator does not publish it)

arg.name: sim_opp
arg.description: True to remap topics to the simulated opponent ones

arg.name: record_bag
arg.description: True to record a rosbag next to the controller (RL / MPC / AC4MPC: model accuracy, latencies, sysid data)

arg.name: bag_dir
arg.description: Directory the bag folder is created in

arg.name: bag_name
arg.description: Bag folder name; empty gives the mode and a timestamp

arg.name: bag_topics
arg.description: Space separated topics to record; append /scan if the lidar is wanted (large)

env.name: BAG_CMD
env.value: n=$(var bag_name); n=${n:-$(var mode)_`date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S`}; exec ros2 bag record -o $(var bag_dir)/$n $(var bag_topics)
